name: earnings_prep
description: Earnings call preparation — financial summary packaging, guidance language drafting, and analyst Q&A preparation. Three modes: assemble key metrics with YoY/QoQ comparisons and vs-guidance variance (Financial Package), draft script language for CFO remarks (Script), and surface likely analyst questions with data-backed answers (Q&A Prep). Triggers: earnings prep, earnings call, earnings transcript, investor relations, guidance language, analyst questions, earnings pack, what do we say to analysts, quarterly earnings, prepare for earnings, Q&A prep, earnings script, earnings highlights, press release prep, verify earnings numbers, tie out, post-call summary, earnings call takeaways.
